beta.changelog: * New: Noxpress Core 1.2.0 adds Install all, Update all and Uninstall all to the Noxpress hub. Each opens a checklist to confirm and then works one plugin at a time through WordPress's own installer, with the usual sha256 and signature check. Install all follows the update channel and does not activate unless ticked; Uninstall all deactivates and deletes (each plugin's own uninstall runs), needs a typed word, and leaves Site Bridge and Data Migrator unticked by default.

* Fix: with Fast Pages as the page cache, saving the settings or a sample now clears the cached product pages (through the suite hook noxpress_purge_page_cache); before, only WP Rocket, LiteSpeed and W3 Total Cache were cleared.
* Noxpress Core 1.2.5.
* Fix: the history CSV passes every fputcsv() argument, so PHP 8.4 prints no deprecation notice into the file.

* New: Noxpress Core 1.2.0 adds Install all, Update all and Uninstall all to the Noxpress hub. Each opens a checklist to confirm and then works one plugin at a time through WordPress's own installer, with the usual sha256 and signature check. Install all follows the update channel and does not activate unless ticked; Uninstall all deactivates and deletes (each plugin's own uninstall runs), needs a typed word, and leaves Site Bridge and Data Migrator unticked by default.

* Fix: uninstall keeps the suite's shared settings (update channel, version list, hub notices) while any Noxpress plugin is still installed. Its list missed the 12 newest plugins, so uninstalling Data Migrator could switch a site from Beta back to Stable.
* Fix: the requests CSV passes every fputcsv() argument, so PHP 8.4 prints no deprecation notice into the file.

* Fix: a plugin activated or updated after Fast Pages was turned on could add a private cookie (noxpress_private_cookies) that the drop-in did not know until the settings were saved again. The drop-in config is now compared with the current one on every admin page and written again when anything differs.
* Fix: an attribute set by the optimizations (e.g. loading or decoding) is replaced only once per tag, as intended.
* Noxpress Core 1.2.5.

* First release: local WebP / AVIF conversion with Imagick or GD in background batches (Action Scheduler or WP-Cron) with a size, time and memory budget, a lock and an optional night window; `<picture>` output for attachment images, featured images and content, optional whole-page pass; test mode, `LIM_DISABLE`, sample test, retry, one image, orphans, delete all; media library column; Imagify detection and adoption of its WebP files; page cache purge through Noxpress Core; abilities for Site Bridge.

* Fix: the app page could miss the «new app version» notice, because it read only the 50 newest releases of the repo and the app's own releases are further down among the plugin releases. It now reads 100 per page, up to 5 pages, until it finds the app's releases.
* Noxpress Core 1.2.5.

* Fix: the limit per IP address reads REMOTE_ADDR, and CF-Connecting-IP only when the request comes from Cloudflare. Headers such as X-Forwarded-For, which any visitor can send, are no longer used, so the limit cannot be bypassed by changing them.

* Initial release.
* Exact, «starts with» and regex rules with 301 / 302 / 307 / 410, only on 404, before WordPress's guesses and Greeklish Permalinks; targets kept by post or term ID.
* Checks for protected addresses, loops, chains and duplicates; «Test an address».
* New 301 rules start as 302 and are suggested for 301 after 7 days; test mode for administrators first.
* 404 log and rule hits in a private file (no IP, user agent or query string), scanner filter, limits, retention, HTTP self-test.
* Target suggestions (old slugs, Greeklish Permalinks, similar slugs and files) with one-click rules; trashed posts and changed term addresses as suggestions.
* Import from Rank Math, Redirection, Yoast SEO Premium, Simple 301 Redirects and CSV; CSV export; JSON backup and restore.
* Abilities redirects/list, top-404, test-url and add; RDR_DISABLE; Greek and English admin.
* Noxpress hub and updates from noxpress.tech (Noxpress Core 1.2.7).
* Noxpress Core 1.2.5: the client portal keeps itself out of page caches through the shared Core helper (DONOTCACHEPAGE and no-store headers), the same as before.
